data: one real UKB-format AP/PA dMRI with paired T1w; DTI tensor from the same subject
change: Retry a non-finite LBFGS level from its unchanged initial control with successively quartered learning rates; record retries and reject only that level if all attempts fail.
fsl_comparison_boundary: report.public.json measures the pre-retry normal path against FSL MMORF 0.3.2. The current first LBFGS attempt uses the same initial control, optimizer settings, closure and loss evaluation; the retry path itself has no FSL numerical-equivalence claim. A fresh same-input voxelwise FSL comparison of current source is not recorded here.
